name: TES Chat
tagline: Real-time messenger for Turon Ecosystem: chats, groups, channels and calls
role: Lead mobile development for Turon Ecosystem

scenes.title: A complete messenger
scenes.body: One inbox for direct chats, groups and channels, with the interface in Uzbek, Russian and English.

scenes.title: Live sync that works offline
scenes.body: Chats sync over WebSocket + MessagePack; history is cached in SQLite and offline sends queue up.

scenes.title: Voice notes, maps and calls
scenes.body: Voice notes and Yandex map locations render inline; the header starts WebRTC voice or video calls.

scenes.title: Group chats for families and teams
scenes.body: Sender names on every bubble; a press-and-hold menu to reply, forward, edit, pin or react.

scenes.title: Channels that broadcast
scenes.body: One-to-many posts in the same inbox; search finds public channels by @handle, and any chat can be muted.

scenes.title: Wallpapers, preset or your own
scenes.body: Color and pattern presets or a gallery photo, set app-wide or overridden for one conversation.

scenes.title: Color themes and accents
scenes.body: Classic, Day, Night and Tinted presets recolor the whole app, plus message accents and light or dark.

scenes.title: Android or the browser
scenes.body: The public page at teschat.org links the Android build and the web client, then lists the features.

scenes.title: Same app on the web
scenes.body: The React Native + Expo codebase also exports the web client; the language switches live, Uzbek to English.
